releaseNotes: HWM DEV 0.2.5.16 uses the exact current stable 0.2.5.14 source as its base, retaining the staged first-show, ShowInTaskbar and resize protections plus Defender endpoint reporting. Tray 1.0.0.12 adds the long-idle ToolTip leak fix by reusing a single WinForms ToolTip component throughout the tray process lifetime.
